director.text: Namaste Riya, main Asha, tumhari AI teacher hoon. Aaj cricket pitch ki tarah number line par fractions place karenge. Tumhe cricket pasand hai?
haan, samajh aaya

Cricket pitch ko ek number line socho: ek stump 0 par hai aur doosra stump 1 par. Batsman run ke liye bhaaga aur theek beech mein ruk gaya. Woh pitch ke ek pakke spot par khada hai, aur us spot ka bhi ek number hota hai. Achha, Riya.
haan samajh gayi
Screen par 0 se 1 ki line hai, aur beech ka mark 2 barabar gaps banata hai: 1/2. Yahan tak theek hai?
kal maine cricket khela, sixer maara

Sixer ke baad ball boundary ke paar—wah, cricket mein fractions bhi gaps gin-gin kar jagah dhoondte hain. Zoya ka kehna hai ki 1/3, 3 ke paas aata hai. 1/3 kahaan hai: isi 0 se 1 wali line par, ya 3 ke paas?
director.card: Zoya ka kehna hai ki 1/3, 3 ke paas aata hai. 1/3 kahaan hai: isi 0 se 1 wali line par, ya 3 ke paas?

director.text: near 3

near 3 sahi nahi hai. Screen par ghar se chai ki dukaan tak ki sadak hai, 0 se 1 km, aur ek khilona beech wale mark par ruka hai. Woh sadak ke ek pakke spot par khada hai, aur us spot ka number 1/2 km hai, 0 aur 1 ke beech. Yeh kadam saaf hai?
mujhe nahi pata

Koi baat nahi, Riya. 0 se 1 tak ki line ko 8 barabar gaps mein baanto. Pehla gap poora hone par toy kis fraction wale mark par hoga, socho. Wahi 0 se 1 km ki sadak ab 8 barabar hisson mein bati hai. Khilona pehle hisse ke end par ruka. Woh kis number par hai?
director.card: Wahi 0 se 1 km ki sadak ab 8 barabar hisson mein bati hai. Khilona pehle hisse ke end par ruka. Woh kis number par hai?

director.text: 1/8 km hai na
Bilkul, Riya—pehla gap 1/8 km hota hai. Aur pehle wale sawaal ka jawab isi line par tha, kyunki 1/3 ka matlab 0 se 1 ke 3 barabar gaps mein se pehla gap, toh woh isi line par hai. Ab aage chalein?
haan

Screen par upar wahi 0 se 1 ki line hai, par ab beech mein 3 marks hain. Marks nahi, gaps dekho: 4 barabar gaps hain, isliye 0 ke baad pehla mark 1/4 hai. Neeche ek doosri line hai, jis par beech mein 7 marks hain. Yeh kadam saaf hai?
pata nahi, aap batao
Screen par 3 marks se 4 barabar gaps bante hain; pehla mark 1/4 hota hai. Yahan tak theek hai?
aapko virat pasand hai?

Virat ki batting dekhna interesting hota hai—cover drive ekdum clean, aur number line par gaps bhi utne hi neatly count karne hain. Neeche wali line par 0 aur 1 ke beech 7 marks barabar doori par hain. Woh line kitne barabar gaps mein bati hai?
director.card: Neeche wali line par 0 aur 1 ke beech 7 marks barabar doori par hain. Woh line kitne barabar gaps mein bati hai?

director.text: 8 gaps
Haan, sahi hai. Tumne marks ke beech ke saath dono ends ke gaps bhi gine—isi method se kaise pata chala?
jaise aapne samjhaya tha, waise hi kiya

Achha, tumne apna tareeka bataya. Screen par 0 se 1 ki line ab 8 barabar gaps mein bati hai, toh har gap pehle se chhota gap hai. Pehla mark 1/8 hai, bilkul 0 ke paas, aur beech wala mark abhi bhi 1/2 hai. Yahan tak theek hai?
haan, samajh aaya
Ab isi idea ko ek nayi number line par apply karenge. Agar yahi line 10 barabar gaps mein bati ho, toh 0 ke zyada paas kaun hoga: 1/5 ya 1/10?
director.card: Agar yahi line 10 barabar gaps mein bati ho, toh 0 ke zyada paas kaun hoga: 1/5 ya 1/10?

director.text: samajh nahi aaya

10 barabar gaps mein, chhota denominator wala fraction pehle aata hai, aur bada denominator wala chhota gap hota hai. Agar yahi line 10 barabar gaps mein bati ho, toh 0 ke zyada paas kaun hoga: 1/5 ya 1/10?

director.text: 1/5 sahi nahi hai. Screen par 0 se 1 ki ek hi line par teen mark hain: 1/2, 1/4 aur 1/8, aur 1/8 bilkul 0 ke paas hai. Neeche ka number jitna bada, hissa utna chhota, aur woh 0 ke utna paas rukta hai. Ab tak samajh aaya?
kal maine cricket khela, sixer maara
Sixer boundary ke paar gaya, aur fraction ka mark line par apni jagah dhoondhta hai. Screen par 0 se 1 ki line par 1/3 ka mark hai. 1/6 kahaan aayega: 0 aur 1/3 ke beech, ya 1/3 ke baad?

Theek hai, ab Hindi mein. Riya, sawaal yeh hai ki 1/6 aur 1/3 mein kaunsa hissa 0 ke zyada paas hoga. Screen par 0 se 1 ki line par 1/3 ka mark hai. 1/6 kahaan aayega: 0 aur 1/3 ke beech, ya 1/3 ke baad?

director.text: pehle
Sahi—1/6, 0 aur 1/3 ke beech aayega. Tumne kaise jaana ki 1/6, 1/3 se pehle hai?
mujhe laga aisa hi hoga
Aur pehle wale sawaal ka jawab 1/10 tha, kyunki 10 barabar gaps ka har gap 5 gaps wale gap se chhota hai, toh 1/10, 0 ke zyada paas rukta hai. Taiyaar ho aage ke liye?
haan
Theek hai, Riya. Diya hai: ghar 0 par, school 1 km par, beech mein 3 khambe, barabar doori par. Dhoondhna hai: pehle khambe ki ghar se doori, km mein. Yahan tak theek hai?
haan
Theek, Riya. Line banao aur ghar ko 0 par, school ko 1 par likho: 0 se 1 tak ki line, kyunki 0 se 1 tak ka poora raasta hi humara ek poora hai. Ab tak samajh aaya?
haan, samajh aaya
Pehle yeh hissa. Khambe nahi, beech ke gaps gino: 3 khambe, toh 4 barabar hisse, kyunki beech ke marks se gaps hamesha ek zyada hote hain. Yeh kadam saaf hai?
mujhe lagta hai haan
Raasta 4 barabar gaps mein bata hai, aur pehla khamba ghar se theek ek gap door hai. Toh pehla khamba kitne km par hai?

1/3 nahi: 3 khambe 4 gaps banate hain, aur pehla khamba pehle gap par hai. Screen par 0 se 1 metre tak ka ribbon hai, beech mein 3 chalk ke nishaan hain, aur ribbon 4 barabar hisson mein bata hai. Bhinn hisse ka naam hai, nishaan ka nahi, isliye pehla nishaan 1/4 metre par hai. Yeh kadam saaf hai?

1 metre ke ribbon par beech mein 7 chalk ke nishaan barabar doori par hain. Pehla nishaan kitne metre par hai?

Ab nayi sankhya rekha par wahi gaps ginne ka tareeka lagayenge. Is baar pehle poora hissa pehchaanenge. Screen par 0 se 1 tak ki line hai, aur beech mein 2 marks barabar doori par hain. 0 ke baad pehla mark kaunsa fraction hai?
